scope: Adopt the desktop-foundation v0.9.0 command grammar (status, commands, tui, doctor, control, approvals, permissions) with the shared envelope; person-gated decide verbs; owner.stop without signals; retire the removed menu bar login item through the foundation retire module; remove the orphaned menubar snapshot.
reviewer: Independent AI reviewer: two separate read-only Claude Code (Opus) processes, not the drafting session
method: Read-only review of the branch against origin/main, then a verification pass over the fixes for the first pass's blocking findings; no edits or tests by the reviewer.
result: First pass: two blocking findings (a build test still read doctor --json at the top level; permissions set reported a turn-on as applied while its job was still running) and eight non-blocking. Fixed: the build test reads the envelope; permissions set waits on the job and reports pending; control stop only reports not-running for a missing or refused socket; a lost answer after approvals decide allow-once is indeterminate and never invites a retry. The verification pass confirmed all fixes with no new double-send path, gate bypass or weakened test. Decide verbs are gated before any control request; the one-time code is read only from the controlling terminal. After merging main (#263, public spelling TextButler), only product-name strings and their snapshots changed; the digests above are for the merged bytes. Third pass (after PR review): doctor --json now exits 0 with readiness in data.ok and the first open setup step as next, so the exit status agrees with the ok envelope; daemon install and daemon uninstall now go through the same person gate as control install and uninstall, so an agent refused control install cannot use the older name. A separate read-only Claude Code (Opus) process reviewed these fixes: no blocking findings; it confirmed the gate resolves before any login-item change and that the new tests fail on the previous code.
remainingLimit: Older product verbs that change other state (contacts enable, replies send, resume) stay decide-legacy and still run for agents until they migrate. The guided terminal's setup prompt still installs the login item on 'y' without the one-time code; it opens only on an interactive terminal and is recorded in cli-parity.md. Plain-text doctor keeps exiting 1 until setup is done; doctor --json exits 0. The local-custody socket client reports every socket error with one message, so control stop cannot tell a permission error from a refused connection. The gate's terminal challenge was not exercised with a live person in this review.
